$Anthropic put Skills over MCP into public beta and made background Tasks and user Elicitation generally available

MCP servers can now ship task-specific skills that Claude can use, while Tasks allow longer-running work and Elicitation lets the model ask for missing details during a tool call. 

The update arrives on the second anniversary of the Model Context Protocol, which Anthropic says has reached more than 700 million monthly SDK downloads.

The change moves MCP from a connection layer toward something closer to packaged behavior. A server can now supply not only tools but also the instructions and constraints for using them. 

How teams write those skills will determine how much control stays with the human versus the agent.

Most agent progress so far has been measured by what models can do. This update is about how the surrounding tools are packaged and constrained.

(practical use)
